standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.player: What are you doing on this shipwreck?

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.npc: Shipwreck?!? Not shipwreck, surely not! Just in port, that's all!

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.player: Don't be silly - half the ship's missing!

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.npc: No no no - the captain's just waiting for the wind to change, then we're off!

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.player: You mean this skeleton sitting here in this chair?

standard-dialogue-before-ghosts-ahoy.npc: You must show more respect to the Captain.

standard-dialogue-after-ghosts-ahoy.npc: Wonderful, wonderful! Mother's coming to get me!
